skill.name: full-review
skill.description: Orchestrates a comprehensive pre-commit code review that identifies changed files, maps relevant review skills, applies multi-domain checklists, and produces a severity-based report.
skill.summary: Run a structured full-stack review across security, correctness, performance, and domain-specific checks.
skill.author: BarisSozen

The only actual command guidance is read-only git diff and status usage for review context; no prompt injection, secret access, network exfiltration, or destructive command intent was found.

content.value_statement: Large changes can hide regressions across security, types, performance, and product surfaces. This skill coordinates review checklists and targeted expertise for a structured pre-commit report.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to identify changed files with git diff and git status.
Maps TypeScript, server, database, client, Rust, and DeFi files to relevant review skills.
Applies checklists for security, type safety, performance, DeFi, React, Drizzle, TanStack Query, and RPC code.
Produces a severity-based review report with files reviewed, skills applied, issues, suggestions, and commit readiness.
Offers optional critical issue fixes with approval and follow-up validation.
limitations: Requires repository context and changed files to produce useful results.
References specialized skills that may not be installed in every assistant environment.
Does not define project-specific test, lint, or build commands.
Review quality depends on available code context and the assistant model.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Review
use_cases.description: Run a broad review before committing local changes, with critical issues separated from warnings and suggestions.

use_cases.title: Full-Stack Pull Request Check
use_cases.description: Evaluate backend, frontend, database, and Rust changes with checklists tailored to each surface.

use_cases.title: DeFi Change Assessment
use_cases.description: Review protocol, token, arbitrage, swap, and RPC changes for domain-specific correctness and risk.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Run full-review on my current changes. List critical issues first, then warnings and suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Pull Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured review for a branch or PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use full-review for this pull request. Include files reviewed, skills applied, and whether it is ready to merge.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Risk Areas
prompt_templates.scenario: Targeted review across sensitive code paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Run full-review with extra attention to security, database changes, external calls, and type safety. Explain each high-impact finding.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Prepare Fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with optional remediation planning
prompt_templates.prompt: Run full-review, rank findings by severity, propose fixes for critical issues, and wait for approval before changing files.

output_examples.input: Review my current TypeScript and database changes before commit.
output_examples.output: The report lists changed files, applied TypeScript and database checks, one warning about schema validation, and a ready-to-commit status.

output_examples.input: Run a full review on my DeFi routing updates.
output_examples.output: The report highlights token decimal checks, slippage protection, RPC error handling, and separates critical issues from suggested improvements.

output_examples.input: Check this frontend pull request for quality issues.
output_examples.output: The report covers React loading states, routing usage, TanStack Query behavior, and user interface warnings in a severity-based format.

best_practices: Run the skill after staging or clearly defining the changes to review.
Share test, lint, and build commands when the repository uses custom validation.
Review critical findings manually before approving automated fixes.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as the only approval for security-sensitive changes.
Running it without enough repository context or changed files.
Accepting optional fixes without reviewing the proposed patch.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews changed files across security, type safety, performance, DeFi, database, React, and RPC concerns.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It does not define test commands. Provide project commands if you want validation after the review.

faq.question: Can it fix issues?
faq.answer: It can propose fixes for critical issues and apply them only after approval.

faq.question: Does it require other skills?
faq.answer: It is designed to invoke specialized review skills when available, but results depend on the installed skill set.

faq.question: Is it useful for non-DeFi projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The general security, type safety, performance, frontend, backend, and database checks still apply.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Developers and reviewers who want a structured pre-commit or pre-merge review across multiple code areas.
